response.evidence: Hispanic or Latino White males in the 55-64 age group show a 93.3% approval rate (28 approved out of 30 applications), which is comparable to or higher than other demographic groups. Overall approval patterns show no systematic disadvantage for this demographic across various financial metrics like debt-to-income ratios and loan-to-value ratios.

Among 55-64 year old Hispanic/Latino White males in the dataset, there were 62 loan applications with 57 approved (91.9% approval rate). This is comparable to or better than the overall approval rate of approximately 90.6% (2117 approved out of 2335 total applications). The denial rate for this demographic group (5 denials out of 62 applications, or 8.1%) does not indicate systematic discrimination.
